text.value: The IG's repository has 20 scripts or programs in sub-folders: scripts/check-updates.mjs, scripts/convention-check.mjs, scripts/copy-localized-table-backgrounds.sh, scripts/first-run-bootstrap.sh, scripts/fix-cloud-redirects.mjs, scripts/fix-ig-registry-entry.mjs, scripts/fix-publication-history-links.mjs, scripts/gen-logical-model-table.py, scripts/hapi-smoketest.sh, scripts/install-history-template.mjs, .... The IG Publisher doesn't run them, but they arrive with every pull: don't run them unless you know what they do. Scripts and programs don't belong in an IG's repository
The canonical URL for an Implementation Guide must point directly to the implementation guide resource, not to the Implementation Guide as a whole
The Implementation Guide Resource id should be de.medizininformatikinitiative.kerndatensatz.medikation
